text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tracen Academy-hosted event 
race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! I'm definitely taking 1st place and 
co-starring with Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you running in the race, big sis?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Not only running, I'm gonna win 
it!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~! There's no way a pipsqueak like you 
can beat those huge and strong girls!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, totally~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What did you say~?! Calling an ally of 
justice a pipsqueak is totally rude!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Besides, size doesn't matter! What matters 
is having a strong heart!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
But! Those guys said that runts will stay 
weaklings forever—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. I don't know who told you what, 
but what matters is who you want to be!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing is impossible if you have strong 
feelings!" Carrotman said that too, didn't 
he?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My name is Biko Pegasus! I'll prove it to 
you in this race, so watch me!

text_block_list.name: Boys
text_block_list.text: Biko... Pegasus...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Dammit! Every time I 
try to push forward, I get blocked...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(It frustrates me, but just like those 
kids said, it's a disadvantage against 
those big, strong runners...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I've trained so much up to this 
day...! There's no way I can lose!)

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: —D-Do your best—!!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Don't give up, Biko Pegasu-u-u-s!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You guys...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: (...That's right. I'm not running alone!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(The friends I trained with, the crowd 
cheering for me... I'm running carrying 
everyone's feelings!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Watch me, Carrotman!! The power of my 
courage and everyone's—)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Uoooooooo!! Pegasus Mach Stri-i-i-i-i-ke!!

And with that, the race ended—concluding 
with a victory for Biko Pegasus, who made 
a furious late charge.

text_block_list.name: Boys
text_block_list.text: U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: O-Oh, it's you guys! Thanks for cheering!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about this morning. We've always 
been bullied and made fun of for being 
short...

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
But today's race gave us courage! What 
matters is having a strong heart, right!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text: —Indeed, that is exactly right!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: C-Carrotman?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~. To think you saw everything from 
our chat this morning...

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to feel embarrassed! The 
way you encouraged those children was 
truly dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, really?! ...Um, you know, I've 
always looked up to you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Just like you in episode 112, I wanted to 
become a hero who gives everyone courage 
through running...!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Thank you! You put on a 
magnificent performance, new hero!!
